answer: Because the timing is logged against the vertex challenge, the zephyr audit can replay the violet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 59 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1697 identities would post 4965 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
